name: agent_nudger_p2_20261103
comment: ANCHOR: AGENT_NUDGER_P2_20261103 — the nudger is registered as an n8n dispatcher lane at scheduler.stage shadow with dispatch.mode dry_run, its allowlist entry points at the repo script and names a non-empty --dry-run, the executor accepts the entry, and the stage clamp turns a requested LIVE run into a dry run (the counterfactual flips the stage to canary and shows live would pass, so the shadow assertion is not vacuous). Hermetic: two committed config files and the pure clamp; no tmux, no network, no state write.
